title: Simple Trade
description: This is a plugin that lets you trade items with other people on a server.
body:
This plugin is beta
  
  How to Use

  Starting a Trade

  1. Stand near another player
  2. Type /trade <playername> (example: /trade Steve)
  3. The other player gets a clickable message to accept

  Trading Process

  1. Trade GUI opens - You'll see a chest-like interface
  2. Left side = Your items (drag items here to offer)
  3. Right side = Their items (you can see what they're offering)
  4. Red pane at bottom = Not ready
  5. Click red pane → Turns green = You're ready
  6. When both players are green → Trade completes automatically!
  7. Click barrier → Cancel trade anytime

  Example Trade Flow

  Player1: /trade Player2
  Player2: [Clicks ACCEPT in chat]
  Both: Add items to left side
  Both: Click ready button (red → green)
  Trade completes! Items exchanged.

  Key Features

  ✅ Safe item-for-item trading
  ✅ No currency needed
  ✅ Visual confirmation system
  ✅ Easy to cancel
  ✅ Items returned if cancelled
  ✅ Trade requests expire in 30 seconds
